contactUs.faq1: Are the accommodations listed on your website pet-friendly?
contactUs.faq1Answer: You can select our pet-friendly option in the menu when planning your trip. We will then try our best to suggest pet-friendly accommodations for you!
contactUs.faq2: Are there any charges that comes with using Itineratum to generate an itinerary?
contactUs.faq2Answer: No, using Itineratum to generate an itinerary is completely free. We believe in making travel planning easy and accessible for everyone. Our basic itinerary generation service is provided at no cost. However, if you choose to book accommodations, flights, or other services through our platform, those will be subject to the respective providers' fees.

Your feedback is invaluable in helping us imporve and provide better travel planning experiences. Whether it's a suggestion, a question, or just a quick note, we're here to listen.

Feel free to explore more features, or if you have additional ideas or need assistance, don't hesitate to get in touch with us directly.

Happy travels,
The Itineratum Team
